newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer plans stronger sales in Czech Republic.
newsitem.headline: Bayer plans stronger sales in Czech Republic.

text.p: German chemicals group Bayer AG said on Thursday it planned to raise sales in the Czech and Slovak Republics by 50 percent by 1998.
In the first half of 1996 Bayer's Czech and Slovak unit Bayer sro posted sales of 70 million marks compared with 58 million marks in the same period of 1995, the group said in a statement.
Bayer added that this rate of growth could not be sustained during the second half of the year.
Bayer said it planned to increase staff in the regions gradually and was particularly optimistic that chemicals, agricultural products and pharmaceuticals would sell very well in the regions.
